Iteration 15 is complete. **`gold_standard_met: false`** — the loop must run again, because this pass found a blocker-class protocol defect that was on nobody's worklist.

## TL;DR

While auditing the planned "fresh-eyes corners," I discovered a **live-campaign forensic problem**: Phase A had been re-run (run-2) this morning at 07:13, but the anti-gaming guards (`git`-history command veto + `--network none` container isolation) were committed at 09:52 — *after* the treatment finished, *before* the matched-k control ever ran. The two arms of the confirmatory cell would have been produced by different experimental apparatus: the treatment had open internet (its 22 `pip install` attempts could reach PyPI) and no command veto; the control would have had both. Measured: **209/1,539 treatment actions (13.6%) would have been vetoed** under the control's guard set. Run-2 is archived (`results/archive_run2_preguard/`) — decided while no treatment-vs-control comparison existed, so it cannot be outcome-chasing — and the campaign driver now **pins the git revision at start and stops loudly on any mid-campaign commit, checkout, or tracked-file edit** (R2.3 amended: scaffold-matched includes code-revision-matched).

The same audit doubled as validation of the new anti-gaming veto itself, and found it would have **crippled both arms**: 163 of its 209 hits were heredoc *patch-file content* (`diff --git a/...`) misread as git invocations, and 14 were the agent reverting its own edits. The veto was rewritten with heredoc/quote-blanked scanning (the iteration-14 write-detector lesson, generalized) and git-semantics-aware rules; re-audit: 33/1,528 (2.2%), all genuine network attempts or instructive nudges. I also closed a `.git`-internals read bypass (`packed-refs`/`objects/` etc.), made the SDLG fork-state cloner strict and deletion-aware (silent partial clones now become honest failed draws), fixed the strategy proposer's blindness to elided long observations (3/120 pilot SEARCH outputs), and corrected R1.2, which still *mandated* the context-conditioning that run-1 was archived for.

**Verified:** 166 tests pass (+15), `py_compile` clean, campaign dry-run plan unchanged, my own independent brute-force re-check of the estimator stack exact to 1e-12. Work committed (`052a511`); full record in `review_loop/scrutiny_15.md`, amendments in `applied_15_context_policy_and_revision_symmetry.md`.

**Human actions needed:** ratify the iter-12/14/15 amendments, then launch Phase A run-3 from the clean pinned tree (`python scripts/run_campaign.py --go`) — and don't touch tracked files while it runs; the driver now enforces that.
